assessment_summary: The equation at line 0387 is ill-typed and dimensionally inconsistent. It applies the operator \partial_{n-k} to a k-chain x, which is invalid unless n-k=k. Similarly, it applies d_k to x^{\perp}, which is also invalid because x^{\perp} would be in C_{n+1-k} given the ambient space \mathbb{F}_q^{n+1} mentioned in the equation. Furthermore, the ambient space dimension is incorrectly stated as n+1 instead of n. The correct relation for projective duality in \mathbb{F}_q^n should map the boundary of a k-chain to the coboundary of an (n-k)-cochain, i.e., (\partial_k x)^{\perp} = d_{n-k}(x^{\perp}).
